#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> n >> s;

    int count = 0;
    int max_len = 0;
    int start = -1;
    bool inside = false;

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)s.length(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == '_') {
            if (start != i - 1) {
                if (inside)
                    ++count;
                else
                    max_len = std::max(max_len, i - 1 - start);
            }
            start = i;
        }
        else if (s[i] == '(') {
            inside = true;
            if (start != i - 1)
                max_len = std::max(max_len, i - 1 - start);
            start = i;
        }
        else if (s[i] == ')') {
            inside = false;
            if (start != i - 1)
                ++count;
            start = i;
        }
    }

    if (start != (int)s.length() - 1)
        max_len = std::max(max_len, (int)s.length() - 1 - start);

    std::cout << max_len << " " << count << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
